active_work_item.reason: Independent QA found another source-grounding defect at exact PR #18 head despite green CI. A potential_risk claim can combine grounded exclusion provenance with an unsupported invented charge assertion because riskConditionSupported accepts the claim when any concern dimension matches; e.g. canonical 'Disposal excluded' can allow 'Disposal is excluded and will incur an additional fee.' The grounded scope dimension masks the ungrounded pricing/fee dimension, violating AC3/AC4/AC5. Exact-head CI 34657868932 is green but lacks this mixed grounded+ungrounded regression. This is a repeated recurrence of the same source-grounding root issue beyond the protocol threshold, so QA escalated to PM and disabled forward work pending a bounded PM decision. No paid/live eval or YELLOW/RED action was performed.
